title: RSR-core: A High-Performance Engine for Low-Bit Matrix-Vector Multiplication
selection_reason: RSR-core implements redundant segment reduction as optimized CPU and CUDA kernels for binary/ternary matrix-vector multiplication, with HuggingFace integration and measured LLM token-generation acceleration; this directly improves low-bit inference.
